title: Changelog
description: Every Cadence release since 2024, written for the people who use it.

props.title: What we shipped
props.subtitle: Every release since 2024, written for the people who use Cadence rather than the people who built it. We eat our own cooking: this page is published by Cadence.

items.title: Read receipts, and the feature they opened next
items.caption: read receipts screen · 1200×675
items.summary: You could already see how many people opened a note. Now you can see *which accounts*, and whether they used the feature afterwards — which is the only way to tell “nobody wants it” apart from “nobody heard about it”.

changes.text: Per-account read receipts on the Team plan, with a 90-day window and CSV export.
Feature-adoption link: attach a feature flag to a note and see the two curves side by side.
The editor preview now matches the published page exactly, including your custom fonts. It did not, and that was embarrassing.
Digests sent at 07:00 could arrive twice for workspaces in UTC+13. Thank you to the two people in Auckland who reported it.
`GET /v1/notes` now paginates at 50 instead of 200. [Migration guide](/docs) — the old behaviour stays available until 1 March 2027 with a header.

items.title: Slack review, and a quieter digest

changes.text: Draft review in Slack: approve or comment without leaving the channel.
Digests now group by week when you ship more than three times in one, instead of sending three emails.
Images pasted from Figma lost their alt text. They no longer do.
One container, any Postgres 14+, and a documented upgrade path. [Self-hosting guide](/docs).
SSO via SAML and OIDC, on the self-hosted and Team plans. Not an enterprise upsell.

more.note: Showing 3 of 148 · paginated rather than infinite, so every release keeps a URL a search engine can reach.
